name: moumenlab
summary: React and Tailwind component lab with 12 copy-paste components, each with a live demo, a blueprint and a shadcn-registry install.
description: A small lab of everyday components — nested menu, OTP input, file-upload staging, schedule builder, command palette, checkout flow and more — each shipped as a single file you own. Every component has a live playground and a build blueprint, and installs into a React 19 + Tailwind v4 project through the shadcn CLI or npx moumenlab add.
contains: 12 components, each a single file: nested menu, OTP input, upload staging, command palette, checkout flow, lists
live playground and source per component
installs with npx moumenlab add or the shadcn CLI; shared theme tokens copied into your project
React 19 + Tailwind v4 + motion, reduced-motion aware
